rules.name: SMF Timeout Burst
rules.description: Detect >5 5xx responses from SMF within 60 seconds
rules.message: SMF timeout burst detected: {count} failures in {window}s. Check UPF connectivity.

rules.name: AUSF Authentication Failure Rate
rules.description: Detect >3 401/403 responses from AUSF within 120 seconds
rules.message: AUSF auth failure spike: {count} auth rejections in {window}s. Possible credential attack or key sync issue.

rules.name: PCF Session Anomaly
rules.description: Detect unexpected PCF interactions or session failures
rules.message: PCF session anomaly: {count} failures in {window}s. Check PCF policy rules.

rules.name: UDM Subscription Not Found
rules.description: Detect 404 responses from UDM indicating missing subscriber profiles
rules.message: UDM subscription not found: {count} 404s in {window}s. Check subscriber provisioning.

rules.name: AMF N2 Accept Missing
rules.description: Detect missing N2 Accept responses after Registration Request
rules.message: AMF N2 registration pending: {count} registrations without N2 Accept in {window}s.

rules.name: IMS SIP Error Rate
rules.description: Detect high SIP 4xx/5xx error rate from PCSCF
rules.message: IMS SIP error rate high: {count} errors ({rate}%) in {window}s from PCSCF.
